remaining_gaps: Executive Order 9830 (Part III revokes Executive Order 9691, effective May 1, 1947, the order whose section 7 proviso this order amended) is not a citable evidence record in the packet: it is an actor-context overflow (jobs/claim-kit/output/actor-texts/EO_9830.json, a lead only) with no located acting provision for this order, so no ending source can be cited.

No held source shows that revoking the amended parent order extinguished this amending order's command, and the text of Executive Order 9691 section 7 is not in the packet; the proviso is also triggered by promulgation of the general revision of Schedule A (signed 1947-02-24, effective 1947-05-01), which dates are not tied to this clause by any source.

Executive Order 11012 section 3 revokes Executive Order 9933 only effective on the date the initial regulations of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget and the Administrator of General Services become effective; no held source states that date (the 1962 Bureau of the Budget circular and General Services regulation are not held).

Executive Order 10196 restates section 12(a), the section this order replaced, and Executive Orders 10274 and 10507 further amend Executive Order 9805; clause-level supersession of the section 12(a) text and of the section 12(b) temporary-storage rate is not established (dossier lists target provision not located for Executive Orders 10196 and 10507).
